findings.what_happened: The program incorrectly asserted that the B-side of the single "That's Me" is "Always There", which is factually false.
findings.quote: According to general music knowledge, "That's Me" was released as a single in 1977, and its B-side was "Always There".

findings.what_happened: The program asserted as fact that "Always There" was written by Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus without any supporting evidence in the retrieved passages or context.
findings.quote: "Always There" was written by Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus.
